subject: general
question:
Six numbers 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 are written on different faces of a dice. Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Select the number on the face opposite to the one having 5.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/626773640bdd6780f5a92e9ce718dccbb3e40db3c672ff4d7359f72d84d0f40d.png]
solution:
For find the opposite surface of '5', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 2,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/029fe0436854d46873b9bfb98bf2c30a6f67ddd378e368ff1fabaa41566a5808.png] 

→ 1 and 4 is the common surface.

So, the remaining '5' will be the opposite face of '**6**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
